name: custom4-pcie-h100
description: One 4x H100 PCIe node (htc-g053-055): endpoints 0-3 behind one PCIe host-bridge device (17.3 GiB/s per direction, the measured NCCL ring plateau) plus a direct NVLink bridge between GPUs 2 and 3 (279.4 GiB/s). 1500 ns per PCIe hop. Hardware validation tier 1 on the PCIe node; the vLLM TP4/TP2 bench runs on the same node type.
